modifiers: left-pointing arrow aimed at upper body
down-pointing arrow aimed at legs or feet
depiction.composition: side view of seated figure on left with two large directional arrows on right

readings.meaning: car climate control, cabin airflow, or AC vent mode
automotive heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC)
seat position or ergonomic posture adjustment

ambiguity: Out of an automotive context, the arrows pointing at and down next to a seated figure could be misread as adjusting a desk chair or taking a seat.

reasoning: This is the standard automotive dashboard pictogram for bi-level cabin airflow (directing air to both the upper body and the footwell). It is a strong, distinctive choice for vehicle climate control, cabin air filter, car AC/heater maintenance, and occasionally seating ergonomics, though outside of car owners some viewers may just see a seated person with arrows.
